text_en: Now concerning the matters about which you wrote: “It is well for a man not to touch a woman. ”
text_cn: 论到你们信上所写的事， 我认为男人不亲近女人倒好。

text_en: But because of cases of sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband.
text_cn: 可是，为了避免淫乱，男人当各有自己的妻子，女人当各有自己的丈夫。

text_en: The husband should give to his wife her conjugal rights, and likewise the wife to her husband.
text_cn: 丈夫对妻子该尽他应尽的义务，妻子对丈夫也是如此。

text_en: For the wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
text_cn: 妻子对自己的身体没有主权，而是丈夫有；同样，丈夫对自己的身体也没有主权，而是妻子有。

text_en: Do not deprive one another except perhaps by agreement for a set time, to devote yourselves to prayer, and then come together again, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text_cn: 你们切不要彼此亏负，除非两相情愿，暂时分房，为专务祈祷；但事后仍要归到一处，免得撒殚因你们不能节制，而诱惑你们。

text_en: This I say by way of concession, not of command.
text_cn: 我说这话，原是出于宽容，并不是出于命令。

text_en: I wish that all were as I myself am. But each has a particular gift from God, one having one kind and another a different kind.
text_cn: 我本来愿意众人都如同我一样，可是，每人都有他各自得自天主的恩宠：有人这样，有人那样。

text_en: To the unmarried and the widows I say that it is well for them to remain unmarried as I am.
text_cn: 我对那些尚未结婚的人，特别对寡妇说：如果他们能止于现状，像我一样，为他们倒好。

text_en: But if they are not practicing self-control, they should marry. For it is better to marry than to be aflame with passion.
text_cn: 但若他们节制不住，就让他们婚嫁，因为与其欲火中烧，倒不如结婚为妙。

text_en: To the married I give this command—not I but the Lord—that the wife should not separate from her husband
text_cn: 至于那些已经结婚的，我命令──其实不是我，而是主命令：妻子不可离开丈夫；

text_en: (but if she does separate, let her remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband should not divorce his wife.
text_cn: 若是离开了，就应该持身不嫁，或是仍与丈夫和好；丈夫也不可离弃妻子。

text_en: To the rest I say—I and not the Lord—that if any believer has a wife who is an unbeliever, and she consents to live with him, he should not divorce her.
text_cn: 对其余的人，是我说，而不是主说：倘若某弟兄有不信主的妻子，妻子也同意与他同居，就不应该离弃她；

text_en: And if any woman has a husband who is an unbeliever, and he consents to live with her, she should not divorce him.
text_cn: 倘若某妇人有不信主的丈夫，丈夫也同意与她同居，就不应该离弃丈夫，

text_en: For the unbelieving husband is made holy through his wife, and the unbelieving wife is made holy through her husband. Otherwise, your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.
text_cn: 因为不信主的丈夫因妻子而成了圣洁的，不信主的妻子也因弟兄而成了圣洁的；不然，你们的儿女就是不洁的，其实他们却是圣洁的。

text_en: But if the unbelieving partner separates, let it be so; in such a case the brother or sister is not bound. It is to peace that God has called you.
text_cn: 但若不信主的一方要离去，就由他离去；在这种情形之下，兄弟或姊妹不必受拘束，天主召叫了我们原是为平安。

text_en: Wife, for all you know, you might save your husband. Husband, for all you know, you might save your wife.
text_cn: 因为你这为妻子的，怎么知道你能救丈夫呢？或者，你这为丈夫的，怎么知道你能救妻子呢？

text_en: However that may be, let each of you lead the life that the Lord has assigned, to which God called you. This is my rule in all the churches.
text_cn: 此外，主怎样分给了各人，天主怎样召选了各人，各人就该怎样生活下去：这原是我在各教会内所训示的。

text_en: Was anyone at the time of his call already circumcised? Let him not seek to remove the marks of circumcision. Was anyone at the time of his call uncircumcised? Let him not seek circumcision.
text_cn: 有人是受割损后蒙召的吗？他就不该掩盖割损的记号；有人是未受割损蒙召的吗？他就不该受割损。

text_en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing; but obeying the commandments of God is everything.
text_cn: 受割损算不得什么，不受割损也算不得什么，只该遵守天主的诫命。

text_en: Let each of you remain in the condition in which you were called.
text_cn: 各人在什么身份上蒙召，就该安于这身份。

text_en: Were you a slave when called? Do not be concerned about it. Even if you can gain your freedom, make use of your present condition now more than ever.
text_cn: 你是作奴隶蒙召的吗？你不要介意，而且即使你能成为自由人，你也宁要守住你原有的身份，

text_en: For whoever was called in the Lord as a slave is a freed person belonging to the Lord, just as whoever was free when called is a slave of Christ.
text_cn: 因为作奴隶而在主内蒙召的，就是主所释放的人；同样，那有自由而蒙召的人，就是基督的奴隶。

text_en: You were bought with a price; do not become slaves of human masters.
text_cn: 你们是用高价买来的，切不要做人的奴隶。

text_en: In whatever condition you were called, brothers and sisters, there remain with God.
text_cn: 弟兄们，各人在什么身份上蒙召，就在天主前安于这身份吧！

text_en: Now concerning virgins, I have no command of the Lord, but I give my opinion as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
text_cn: 论到童身的人，我没有主的命令，只就我蒙主的仁慈，作为一个忠信的人，说出我的意见：

text_en: I think that, in view of the impending crisis, it is well for you to remain as you are.
text_cn: 为了现时的急难，依我看来，为人这样倒好。

text_en: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be free. Are you free from a wife? Do not seek a wife.
text_cn: 你有妻子的束缚吗？不要寻求解脱；你没有妻子的束缚吗？不要寻求妻室。

text_en: But if you marry, you do not sin, and if a virgin marries, she does not sin. Yet those who marry will experience distress in this life, and I would spare you that.
text_cn: 但是你若娶妻，你并没有犯罪；童女若出嫁，也没有犯罪；不过这等人要遭受肉身上的痛苦，我却愿意你们免受这些痛苦。

text_en: I mean, brothers and sisters, the appointed time has grown short; from now on, let even those who have wives be as though they had none,
text_cn: 弟兄们，我给你们说：时限是短促的，今后有妻子的，要像没有一样；

text_en: and those who mourn as though they were not mourning, and those who rejoice as though they were not rejoicing, and those who buy as though they had no possessions,
text_cn: 哭泣的，要像不哭泣的；欢乐的，要像不欢乐的；购买的，要像一无所得的；

text_en: and those who deal with the world as though they had no dealings with it. For the present form of this world is passing away.
text_cn: 享用这世界的，要像不享用的，因为这世界的局面正在逝去。

text_en: I want you to be free from anxieties. The unmarried man is anxious about the affairs of the Lord, how to please the Lord;
text_cn: 我愿你们无所挂虑：没有妻子的，所挂虑的是主的事，想怎样悦乐主；

text_en: but the married man is anxious about the affairs of the world, how to please his wife,
text_cn: 娶了妻子的，所挂虑的是世俗的事，想怎样悦乐妻子：这样他的心就分散了。

text_en: and his interests are divided. And the unmarried woman and the virgin are anxious about the affairs of the Lord, so that they may be holy in body and spirit; but the married woman is anxious about the affairs of the world, how to please her husband.
text_cn: 没有丈夫的妇女和童女，所挂虑的是主的事，一心使身心圣洁；至于已出嫁的，所挂虑的是世俗的事，想怎样悦乐丈夫。

text_en: I say this for your own benefit, not to put any restraint upon you, but to promote good order and unhindered devotion to the Lord.
text_cn: 我说这话，是为你们的益处，并不是要设下圈套陷害你们，而只是为叫你们更齐全，得以不断地专心事主。

text_en: If anyone thinks that he is not behaving properly toward his fiancée, if his passions are strong, and so it has to be, let him marry as he wishes; it is no sin. Let them marry.
text_cn: 若有人以为对自己的童女待的不合宜，怕她过了韶华年龄，而事又在必行，他就可以随意办理，让她们成亲，不算犯罪。

text_en: But if someone stands firm in his resolve, being under no necessity but having his own desire under control, and has determined in his own mind to keep her as his fiancée, he will do well.
text_cn: 但是谁若心意坚定，没有不得已的事，而又能随自己的意愿处置，这样心里决定了要保存自己的童女，的确作得好；

text_en: So then, he who marries his fiancée does well; and he who refrains from marriage will do better.
text_cn: 所以，谁若叫自己的童女出嫁，作得好；谁若不叫她出嫁，作得更好。

text_en: A wife is bound as long as her husband lives. But if the husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, only in the Lord.
text_cn: 丈夫活着的时候，妻子是被束缚的；但如果丈夫死了，她便自由了，可以随意嫁人，只要是在主内的人。

text_en: But in my judgment she is more blessed if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
text_cn: 可是，按我的意见，如果她仍能这样守下去，她更为有福：我想我也有天主的圣神。
